anna_dev: Heads up — hitting a parity issue while wiring the sampleapp onboarding flow. The REST createRoute endpoint supports `visibility: 'public' | 'private'` but the Node SDK createRoute call seems to ignore the `visibility` param and defaults to private. Can anyone confirm?

sam_sre: Oh yeah that sounds bad. Which SDK version? and can you paste the minimal repro?

anna_dev: Using `@redwood/sdk@0.14.2`. Minimal call: ```js
await client.createRoute({ name: 'onboard-welcome', model: 'redwood-mini', visibility: 'public' })
```
It returns 201 but the route shows private in the console. Console API audit log shows REST payload included visibility public at 2023-10-04T12:22:11Z.

maria_dx: I remember a quirk — we renamed `visibility` -> `isPublic` in an internal change and forgot to map it in the JS binding. Looks like SDK still sends `{ isPublic: true }` for older calls but the runtime expects `visibility: 'public'`.

anna_dev: Great catch. The sampleapp onboarding script uses the SDK so new customers will get private routes by default. That explains the support ticket from ACME who couldn't share a dev route.

sam_sre: Can we hotfix the SDK to translate both shapes `(visibility|'isPublic')` when serializing? Short-term patch: accept both in the runtime too. I'll open an infra fallback so older SDKs don't break.

maria_dx: Working on a PR for the SDK glue now. Proposed behavior: if `visibility` present, pass it through; else if `isPublic` boolean present, convert to `visibility: isPublic ? 'public' : 'private'`. Tests in binder + unit.

anna_dev: For the onboarding doc, I'll add a note and a migration snippet. Also adding a small smoke test to the sampleapp e2e to assert route visibility after create.

sam_sre: Filed infra ticket: INF-1294 to add tolerant parsing on the control plane side. Deploy-bot: deploy scheduled to staging at 2023-10-04T20:00Z for the tolerant parse change. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

deploy-bot: Deployment queued — staging rollout id stg-20231004-7.

maria_dx: PR created: sdk-js#842, includes tests + changelog. Please review.

anna_dev: TL;DR: SDK/REST param drift on route visibility causing onboarding friction for new users. Fixes in flight (SDK PR + infra tolerant parse); adding sampleapp test and docs note. Thanks! :raised_hands:
